risk_summary: The disclosure is generally transparent and quantitatively detailed, including revenue trends, commission components, contingent commissions, earn-out liabilities, and segment performance. Risk tone is mildly positive due to sustained historical growth, but COVID-19, exposure-unit volatility, catastrophe risk, and dependence on insurer pricing remain material uncertainties. Long, highly nested sentences and extensive non-GAAP definitions increase interpretive complexity.
